messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — prepping Acme's QBR (next Tues). Their credits velocity spiked during onboarding tests; want to sync on runway and alerting. Quick ask: can eng confirm spend forecast for next 14 days and set a temporary budget alert at 30% over baseline? :eyes:

ben_ao: Noted. Onboarding is ~60% complete, but they flipped to embed-heavy flows yesterday. I can share usage snapshot. Do we want soft alerts (Slack only) or enforced throttles?

raj_fin: I ran a quick projection — baseline tokens/day 120k, current velocity 420k/day. If trend continues they'll exhaust monthly credit pool by day 9. Recommend a soft alert at +50% and an enforce throttle at +200% above baseline. CSV with daily sim: https://redwood.internal/reports/acme-velocity.csv

olivia_se: I can provide a mitigation checklist for enablement: ramp down batch sizes, enable KV caching, switch to 8-bit quant model variant where possible. Here's a sample alert rule we use:

```
rule: budget-velocity-guard
scope: account:acme
condition:
  - metric: tokens_per_minute
    threshold: 180000
    window: 15m
actions:
  - notify: #customer-success
  - action: reduce_max_batch_size(32)
```

maria_cs: Love it. Ben — can you confirm if Devs are OK with reduce_max_batch_size? If so we'll roll soft alert Thursday, enforced throttle Friday morning.

ben_ao: I'll ping the dev owner @sara-eng and loop back. Also, can support prep a short do/don't doc for the customer? :thumbsup:

olivia_se: I'll draft a 1-pager and attach to the QBR packet. Also adding a short script they can run to sample token usage:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?account=acme | jq '.tokens_last_24h'
```

maria_cs: Timeline: draft alert by Thu 10:00am, dev confirmation by Thu EOD, soft alert Thu 4:00pm, enforced Fri 9:00am. If anything slips we escalate to oncall. Thanks all :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy accepted: alert-config v1.2 staged to prod namespace 'acct-acme' by olivia_se

ben_ao: Received, thanks. I'll update the QBR slide deck with the runway explainer.
